Field notes.

Practical reading on search, healthcare revenue and running a business. Browse guides in English and Roman Urdu.

47 guides

Digital marketing

SEO cost in Pakistan

Two businesses can ask for SEO and need completely different work. A usable quote explains which pages, locations and problems the team will take on.

Digital marketing

What is local SEO?

Local search helps customers discover a business that serves their area. A useful listing lets someone decide whether to call, visit or ask for a quote.

Digital marketing

What is an SEO audit?

An SEO audit examines why important pages struggle to appear in search or attract suitable visitors. Its most useful output is a short, ordered work plan.

Digital marketing

What is technical SEO?

Technical SEO covers the systems that let search engines reach and interpret a website. A customer can see the effects too, especially when a page loads slowly or a link breaks.

Healthcare revenue

What is medical billing?

Medical billing connects a documented patient visit with a claim, a payer decision and a payment record. A practice needs to see which stage each claim has reached.

Healthcare revenue

Common reasons for claim denials

A denial log is more useful when it shows where a problem began. Grouping payer responses lets a practice fix repeated mistakes at the right point in its workflow.

Healthcare revenue

What is prior authorization?

Some health plans require a practice to request approval before particular services. The administrative task is to check the applicable requirement, prepare the request and follow the payer’s decision.

Healthcare revenue

What is provider credentialing?

Credentialing is the review of a provider’s qualifications. A practice also needs to track payer enrollment and effective dates before it can rely on a particular network arrangement.

Business consultancy

What does a business consultant do?

A consultant helps a founder or management team make a specific decision and organise the work that follows. The most useful brief describes the decision holding the business back.

Business consultancy

What is process improvement?

Process improvement means changing how work moves from one person to the next. A sensible starting point is a familiar task that regularly causes delays, rework or customer complaints.

Writing a business case

Start with the handoffs people ask about every week. A shared view of work and responsibility can be more valuable than adding another application.

Growth planning starts with a choice about which customers to serve and what the business can deliver reliably as demand increases.

Choosing software for a growing business

Choose a tool after you understand the work it must support. A good trial exposes both the useful features and the extra admin it might create.

Choosing business blogs worth reading

A reading list earns its place when it helps someone make a better decision. Start with a question your team is facing this month.

Where AI can fit in a construction workflow

Help customers recognise what makes your business different

Specific details give a customer a reason to choose you. Start with something buyers already value and that the team can deliver consistently.

Planning a business podcast

Business consultancy

Questions founders should test early

Early assumptions about demand, pricing and delivery affect the rest of a startup plan. Make the important ones visible while a change is still affordable.

Five stages of team development

The forming, storming, norming, performing and adjourning model gives a team vocabulary for discussing how it works together.

Business consultancy

How much do business consultants charge?

A useful quote ties the fee to a decision, an output and the amount of support your team needs to put it into practice.
